title: Linear-confidence work budget
statement: For each fixed $k\in\mathbb{N}$, as $n$ and $b$ tend jointly to infinity, the total work budget for dimension $n$, parameter $k$, and dyadic failure parameter $2^{-(b+1)}$ is $O\!\left((n+1)^{\lfloor 3k/4\rfloor+4}(b+1)\right)$.
